Subject: Guest idea: how to stop paying for overlapping AI tools

Hi Latent Space team,

Quick guest pitch for Latent Space: most teams now pay for 2+ overlapping AI subscriptions. I run AIToolsEssentials — we review AI tools with verified pricing and keep/cut verdicts. I can walk through:

- The most common overlaps (assistant × 2, meeting notes × 2, coding × 2)
- How to run a one-week test before any renewal
- What "worth it" actually means per tool

Audience walks away able to cut at least one subscription. Happy to prep a one-pager in advance.

AIToolsEssentials

pitch:
Subject: Source for The Decoder — AI tool pricing verification

Hi The Decoder team,

I've been following The Decoder and appreciate how clearly you mark sponsored posts and keep them separate from editorial.

I wanted to offer a source: AIToolsEssentials reviews AI tools with verified pricing from official pages and dated evidence. We track 76 tools and re-verify pricing against vendor official pages.

One finding your readers might find useful:
- The pattern is overlap, not duplication: across our tracked tools, the coding stack is the most expensive one to double up on — Cursor Pro is $20/mo and Claude Max starts at $100/mo (cursor.com and claude.com pricing, snapshots dated in our Pricing Watch page).

I'm happy to provide specific pricing comparisons, official page links, or commentary.

AIToolsEssentials
https://aitoolsessentials.com
